notes.title: Hotfix 1.01 - Resolution Fix and Driver Academy
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This little patch is for fixing the 0x0 resolution. The game now checks your resolution on startup and if it is unrealistically low, it will reset your resolution settings.
Otherwise you should be able to find the option data in the following path:

C:/Users/[USER]/AppData/LocalLow/Rand_Exe Studios/Formula Racing Manager

Alternatively you can search in Windows for %AppData% and go to LocalLow > Rand_Exe_Studios > Formula Racing Manager and find the config.json


In addition there was a bug that would duplicate an Academy driver when signed in the following season. This bug should not occur anymore.

If you find any more bugs, have some balance issues or generally want to talk to me about the game, feel free to throw yourselves into the steam discussions :)

Best wishes and good racing
Jason

notes.title: 0.95b Hotfix for Early Access Version
notes.content: The Early Access Version was released with a bug that would crash the game on start-up and open Discord when Discord was not open. This problem has been fixed.
